name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: A keyed semantic list with insertion, removal, controlled drag reordering and keyboard-accessible handles.
docs:
## Overview

Animate a small list using stable entity keys. Supply onReorder to enable vertical drag handles and keyboard reordering. The host owns the order and persistence; removed items become inert during exit. This is not virtualization or cross-list dragging. See /docs/animated-list.
